title: Derived vector anchors for the DGR Figure 3 black-hole susceptibility curve

edition.name: DeWolfe--Gubser--Rosen arXiv source archive v2
edition.citation: O. DeWolfe, S. S. Gubser, and C. Rosen, Phys. Rev. D 83, 086005 (2011)
edition.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; derived numerical facts only

conventions.name: abscissa
conventions.value: temperature in MeV after the frozen source scale lambda_T = 252 MeV
conventions.rationale: The source scale is not refitted by HoloForge.

conventions.name: anchor extraction
conventions.value: PDF ticks define affine maps; ordinates are linearly interpolated between adjacent blue vector-path vertices in ZeroMuComparison.pdf
conventions.rationale: The extracted Figure 3 file has SHA-256 bf1dfec799335ca3b8db124a188a4c7d17e1a3f73ddf31f2606f58fa7492f65b; raw artwork is not redistributed.

conventions.name: data boundary
conventions.value: Only the DGR blue black-hole path is included; third-party lattice markers are excluded
conventions.rationale: The benchmark reproduces the source model curve rather than reusing lattice data.
